text:
```yaml
name: Mark stale issues and pull requests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 1 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
            
            If this issue is still relevant and you'd like to keep it open, please leave a comment or add the "keep-open" label.
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you for your contributions.
            
            If this PR is still relevant and you'd like to keep it open, please leave a comment or add the "keep-open" label.
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue was closed because it has been stale for 7 days with no activity.
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request was closed because it has been stale for 7 days with no activity.
          days-before-stale: 30
          days-before-close: 7
          exempt-issue-labels: "keep-open,bug,enhancement,documentation"
          exempt-pr-labels: "keep-open,bug,enhancement,documentation"
          stale-issue-label: "stale"
          stale-pr-label: "stale"
          operations-per-run: 100
```
